verdict.rationale: IVS documents multitrack video, where the publisher's device sends multiple quality versions so IVS does not have to generate them, and a data-plane API for implementing client multitrack support. That covers the publisher-side simulcast half of the story. The pack never states that IVS selects or adapts which rendition each viewer or subscriber receives based on their bandwidth; this is only implied by HLS (m3u8) output. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-subscriber bandwidth-adaptive layer selection, simulcast or layered behavior for real-time stages, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, publishers send layered or simulcast video and the service adapts the layer each subscriber receives to their bandwidth

citations.quote: When enabled, you send multiple video quality versions directly from your device and are charged a lower price as Amazon IVS does not need to generate these versions.
Describes in detail the IVS data-plane API for broadcast-software developers implementing client support for multitrack video.
